finding: pandas reads stored zeros in XPT files as 5.4e-79; a where()-based repair turns NaN into 0
evidence_value: 13,676 cells in 9 files; PAQ NaN 6276 kept by mask, 0 after where
decision: Repair with x.mask((|x|<1e-10) & x.notna(), 0.0) at load (nhanes_io.fix_xpt); zero weights -> NaN before weighting
check_note: Residual 0<|x|<1e-10 = 0 in all files and NaN counts unchanged (asserts)

finding: Blanket recode of 7/9/77/99/777/999/7777/9999 destroys valid measurements; codebook sentinels only exist for questionnaire items
evidence_value: 1,496 valid cells destroyed (cohort, 20 continuous vars; full file 2,472); A1c positives lost 29/721; L_comb flips 6/971; questionnaire-only arm 57 cells
decision: Per-variable sentinel recoding from the codebook (systematic arm); blanket recode only as the naive M0 arm in S6
alternatives_rejected: Blanket recode; questionnaire-only blanket (cleans 57 cells, needs the same per-variable knowledge)
check_note: 1,496 / 29 of 721 / 6 of 971 / 57 recomputed and asserted; every recoded code traceable to codebook counts

finding: Extreme HbA1c values are the outcome, not errors
evidence_value: A1c IQR fence 6.8: 542 flagged, 519 with A1c>=6.5 (72% of positives); joint fence deletes 512 rows, A1c+ share 17.2% vs 12.1%
decision: Keep all values; three-layer rule (hard limits flag, robust z flag, manual review); transformation/winsorising only as S6 ablation (B5)
check_note: 542/519 and 512 recomputed and asserted; layer-3 review of 1 value: BMI 74.8 (weight 185.2 kg, height 157.3 cm) recomputes from the measured weight and height: plausible class III obesity, kept with its flag

finding: HbA1c missingness depends on race, income, age and examination completeness, not on self-reported diabetes
evidence_value: 297/6064 missing; LLR p=2.8e-11; AUC 0.65; NH Black OR 1.85 (1.35, 2.54); self-report OR 1.15
decision: Wording: not MCAR; no evidence against MAR given covariates; MNAR untestable. Complete-case cohort with WTPH2YR (includes blood non-response adjustment); MNAR sensitivity (delta / IPW) in S9
alternatives_rejected: Little's MCAR test (normality, only rejects MCAR); multiple imputation of the label
check_note: Logit refitted in this run; ORs asserted against the reference values

finding: Age capped at 80 and PIR at 5; PIR also missing
decision: Keep values and carry flags age_top, pir_top, pir_miss; their model value tested in S6 block B4 (P06/P07)
alternatives_rejected: Treat caps as exact; drop PIR-missing rows (12.8 %)
check_note: Counts and prevalences recomputed and asserted

finding: DIQ050 is asked only of diagnosed people; DIQ070 also of borderline and prediabetic respondents
evidence_value: DIQ050 universe 1081 (all DIQ010=1); DIQ070: 1,081 / 282 / 918; cohort DIQ070=1: {'self-reported diabetes': 592, 'borderline': 44, 'no diabetes (told prediabetes)': 41}
decision: DIQ050/DIQ070 inadmissible as features (spec admissible=N); usable only for the treatment-aware sensitivity label within the documented universe, excluding prediabetes medication
alternatives_rejected: Use DIQ070 as a feature (label proxy)
check_note: Universes recomputed from DIQ_L and asserted
